content.text: Sherman captured Savannah after Fort McAllister fell, marched through the Carolinas, entered Columbia, reached Fayetteville and Goldsboro, and helped force Johnston’s surrender. Thomas defeated Hood at Nashville. Grant’s forces captured Petersburg and Richmond; Lee retreated to Appomattox Court House and surrendered on April 9, 1865. The text then shifts to fiction: Dan Mordaunt tracks kidnapped Althea from New York to Donovan’s Brooklyn saloon, disguises himself as an Italian musician, rescues her, and returns her to his mother. Hartley is arrested, while Harriet Vernon adopts Dan’s family. In a socialist novel, Philpot is killed by a falling ladder in a gable accident, Ruth leaves Easton and hides at Owen’s house, and Hunter later dies by suicide. Barrington rejects electoral politics, remains committed to socialism, and encounters poverty, exploitation, and political manipulation.
